name: toasts
drive: (()=>{const names=['Success','Info','Warning','Danger','With an action','Stays until dismissed'];const hit=[];for(const n of names){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===n);if(b){b.click();hit.push(n);}}return hit.join(',');})()

name: lookup confirm, row pending
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const i=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-haspopup=grid]')][1];if(!i)return 'no lookup';i.focus();i.value='cloud';i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));let g;for(let n=0;n<40;n++){await w(150);g=document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-controls'));if(g&&g.querySelector('tbody tr[aria-selected]')&&i.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant'))break;}if(!g)return 'no grid';i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true}));for(let n=0;n<50;n++){await w(100);if(g.querySelector('tr[aria-selected=true]'))return 'pending';}return 'no pending row: active='+i.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant')+' expanded='+i.getAttribute('aria-expanded')+' rows='+g.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[aria-selected]').length+' connected='+g.isConnected;})()

name: stepper, step error flagged
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const set=(l,v)=>{const lab=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim().startsWith(l));const i=document.getElementById(lab.htmlFor);i.value=v;i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};const next=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('section button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Next').click();set('Email','ada@example.com');set('Password','correcthorse');await w(300);next();await w(800);set('Workspace name','acme');await w(300);next();await w(1200);return document.querySelector('nav li[data-state=error]')?'flagged':'no error state';})()

name: split button menu open
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t=document.querySelector('button[aria-haspopup=menu]:not([disabled])');if(!t)return 'no split toggle';t.click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(document.querySelector('[role=menu]'))return 'menu: '+document.querySelectorAll('[role=menu] [role=menuitem]').length+' items, focus '+(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('role')??'none');}return 'no menu';})()

name: message dismissed, live message shown
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const d=document.querySelector('.zen-message button[aria-label=Dismiss]');if(!d)return 'no dismiss';d.click();const f=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Fail to save');if(!f)return 'no fail button';f.click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(document.querySelector('.zen-message[role=alert]'))return 'alert shown';}return 'no alert';})()

name: es-DO: split button menu open
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t=document.querySelector('button[aria-haspopup=menu]:not([disabled])');if(!t)return 'no split toggle';if(t.getAttribute('aria-label')!=='Más opciones')return 'no translation: '+t.getAttribute('aria-label');t.click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(document.querySelector('[role=menu]'))return 'menu open, '+document.documentElement.lang;}return 'no menu';})()

name: breadcrumb expanded, focus on revealed level
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const n=document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb, collapsed"]');if(!n)return 'no breadcrumb';const before=n.querySelectorAll('li').length;const b=n.querySelector('button');if(!b)return 'no ellipsis, levels '+before;b.click();for(let i=0;i<30;i++){await w(100);if(!n.querySelector('button'))break;}const after=n.querySelectorAll('li').length;const f=document.activeElement?.textContent.trim();if(after!==5)return 'no expansion: '+before+' -> '+after;if(f!=='Projects')return 'no focus move: '+f;return 'levels '+before+' -> '+after+', focus '+f;})()

name: tabs, arrow key selects next
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const l=document.querySelector('[role=tablist][aria-label=Project]');if(!l)return 'no tablist';const t=l.querySelector('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]');t.focus();l.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowRight',bubbles:true}));for(let i=0;i<30;i++){await w(100);if(l.querySelector('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]')!==t)break;}const s=l.querySelector('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]');if(s===t)return 'no selection change';if(document.activeElement!==s)return 'no focus on selected: '+document.activeElement?.textContent.trim();l.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'End',bubbles:true}));await w(600);const e=l.querySelector('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]').textContent.trim();if(e!=='Settings')return 'no End: '+e;return 'selected '+s.textContent.trim()+' then '+e+', panel '+document.getElementById(l.querySelector('[aria-selected=true]').getAttribute('aria-controls'))?.textContent.trim().slice(0,20);})()

name: accordion, one open at a time, bound
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('details')].filter(x=>x.closest('section')&&x.name);if(d.length<2)return 'no accordion';if(!d[0].open)return 'no initial open';d[1].querySelector('summary').click();await w(900);if(d[0].open)return 'no exclusivity';if(!d[1].open)return 'no open';const bound=[...document.querySelectorAll('code')].find(c=>/^Open = /.test(c.textContent))?.textContent;if(bound!=='Open = False')return 'no binding: '+bound;return 'exclusive, '+bound;})()

name: segmented button chosen
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const f=[...document.querySelectorAll('fieldset')].find(x=>x.querySelector('legend')?.textContent.trim().startsWith('Billing period'));if(!f)return 'no segmented';const l=[...f.querySelectorAll('label')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Yearly');l.click();await w(700);const r=l.querySelector('input');if(!r.checked)return 'no check';const bg=getComputedStyle(l).backgroundColor;const other=getComputedStyle([...f.querySelectorAll('label')][0]).backgroundColor;if(bg===other)return 'no selected fill: '+bg;const bound=[...document.querySelectorAll('code')].some(c=>c.textContent==='year');return bound?'year bound, fill '+bg:'no binding';})()

name: one-time code, partly typed with a letter
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const i=document.querySelector('input[autocomplete=one-time-code]');if(!i)return 'no otp';i.focus();i.value='12a';i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(i.value==='12')break;}if(i.value!=='12')return 'no cleaning: '+i.value;const cells=[...i.parentElement.querySelectorAll('span.font-mono')];const active=cells[2];const c=getComputedStyle(active).borderColor;const idle=getComputedStyle(cells[4]).borderColor;if(c===idle)return 'no active cell: '+c;return 'value 12, cells '+cells.map(x=>x.textContent||'_').join('')+', active border '+c;})()

name: key lookup picks a Guid
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const i=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-haspopup=grid]')][2];if(!i)return 'no key lookup';i.focus();i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowDown',bubbles:true}));let g;for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);g=document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-controls'));if(g&&g.querySelector('tbody tr'))break;}if(!g)return 'no grid';g.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')[1].click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(i.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='false')break;}const code=i.closest('.zen-card, section')?.parentElement?.querySelector('code')?.textContent;const bound=[...document.querySelectorAll('code')].map(c=>c.textContent).find(t=>/^[0-9a-f]{8}-/.test(t));if(!bound)return 'no guid bound, field '+i.value;i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowDown',bubbles:true}));await w(600);const sel=document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-controls'))?.querySelector('tr[aria-selected=true]')?.textContent.trim().slice(0,22);if(!sel)return 'no row selected on reopen';return i.value+' -> '+bound+', reopened on '+sel;})()
